2025 – Q34 Passage #4

Lyle wants to add a supporting sentence to the fifth paragraph (sentences 22–27). Which sentence should be added after sentence 26?

Ⓐ Likewise, orange juice became a necessity in the morning because of the benefits of vitamin C.

Ⓑ Today people who are lactose intolerant are able to choose from other varieties of milk, such as soy, rice, almond, and coconut milk.

Ⓒ Vitamin D occurs naturally in milk, but vitamin D can also be produced in the body through exposure to sunlight.

Ⓓ Naturally the cereal manufacturers promoted milk because it tastes best with cereal.
